cash_intro_1: Ndalama zagwiritsidwa ntchito kwa zaka mazana ndipo ndizo ndalama zamaonekedwe zodziwika kwambiri padziko lonse.
cash_intro_2: Bitcoin ndi ndalama zadigitala zomwe zinapangidwa mu 2009 zomwe zimagwira ntchito modziyimira popanda boma kapena olamulira alikulu.
cash_intro_3: Koma kodi ndalama zamaonekedwe zimasiyana bwanji ndi ndalama zadigitala ngati Bitcoin? Tiyeni tione kusiyana kwakukulu pakati pa Bitcoin ndi Ndalama.
point_1_summary_1: Bitcoin imayenda pa internet kulikonse mu mphindi zochepa. Ndalama zenizeni zimafunika kupezeka pamalo kapena otumiza odalirika — simungatumize ndalama zenizeni za $20 kudzera mu imelo.
point_2_summary_1: Bitcoin imagwira ntchito chimodzimodzi kulikonse. Ndalama zenizeni zili zochepa pamalo, mtengo wa kusinthana, ndi kuvomerezeka kwa kumudzi.
point_3_summary_1: Maboma akhoza kuthetsa ndalama zenizeni mwadzidzidzi — India idachita zomwezo mu 2016. Ngakhale popanda kuchotsa, ndalama zenizeni zimataya mtengo wake chifukwa cha
point_3_summary_3: Bitcoin singathetsedwe ndi boma lililonse kapena ulamuliro uliwonse.
point_4_summary_1: Ndalama zenizeni zikhoza kupangidwa zabodza, nthawi zina mwaluso. Bitcoin imagwiritsa ntchito cryptography yomwe imapangitsa kupanga zabodza kosatheka.
point_5_summary_1: Bitcoin ilibe ulamuliro wapakatikati. Ndalama zenizeni zimaperekedwa ndi maboma amene akhoza kusindikiza zambiri, kusintha mawonekedwe, kapena kuthetsa makalata malinga ndi kufuna kwawo.
point_6_summary_1: Ndalama zenizeni zili zovuta ku kuba, moto, kutaya, ndi kulanda. Bitcoin imatha kusungidwa motetezeka
point_6_summary_3: pa foni kapena chipangizo cha hardware.
point_7_summary_1: Bitcoin imagawanika m'magawo 100 miliyoni a satoshi, zomwe zimathandiza malipiro ang'ono akukula kulikonse. Ndalama zenizeni zili ndi malire ang'ono — simungagawane senti imodzi.
